name: Governed PR Terminalization and Documentation Convergence

routing.asset_registry: CrownThrive Master IP & Asset Registry — Canonical

activation_rule: Apply to every CLEAN/source/docs PR at run start and after each main/merge change; classify, repair/restack/merge/close and leave no unowned open backlog.
maintenance_rule: Never force merge, self-certify, delete preserved predecessor branches, or conflate source merge with provider publication readback. Use expected-head merge only after all applicable exact-head gates/reviews genuinely pass.
